summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: new Update container (prologue, algebra) beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update container; empty-request early exit builds the prologue via translatePrologue from q.prologue[0] (or empty), base and initNs; imports Update. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; docstring updated. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) beside prepareQuery, sets _original_args; processUpdate and the string path unchanged. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate. (6) test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py: new unittest module covering prepare-then-Graph.update, reuse across graphs, initNs resolution, direct evalUpdate, container shape, empty and prologue-only requests, empty update string, and a no-mutation check using (op.name, repr(op)) snapshots. Not verified: no tests were run, so the new tests and existing prepareQuery and DAWG tests are unconfirmed. Formatting checked by hand against black at 88 columns. Not covered: an initBindings test was not added. test_dawg.py line 322 pprintAlgebra now prints the container repr (inside a try block, not modified).
